description: This file defines a template class 'JsonRpcInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, which provides an interface for handling JSON-RPC communication over WebSockets. It includes methods for sending requests, handling incoming messages, managing asynchronous responses, and processing notifications and responses. The class is designed to be inherited and used with a derived class that implements the 'send' method. The file also includes necessary headers, licensing information, and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: JsonRpcInterface
classes.description: A template class providing an interface for JSON-RPC communication over WebSockets, supporting request sending, response handling, and notification processing.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request and waits for the response, returning success status based on the response.

methods.name: setNotificationHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback function to handle incoming JSON-RPC notifications.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, dispatching it as a response or notification.

methods.name: getAsyncResponse
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous response with a timeout, processes the response if available.

methods.name: createFutureResponse
methods.description: Creates and stores a promise for an expected response identified by request ID.

methods.name: removePromise
methods.description: Removes the stored promise associated with a request ID.

methods.name: isRequestProcessingOngoing
methods.description: Checks if a request with a given ID is currently being processed.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles an incoming response message, fulfilling the associated promise.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes a response string, extracting success status and validating the response.
